topics.name: Time & Space Complexity (Asymptotic Notation)
topics.description: Big-O, Big-Omega, Big-Theta notation, recurrence relations, best/average/worst case analysis.

topics.name: Arrays & Dynamic Memory Allocation
topics.description: Contiguous memory layout, pointers, dynamic arrays (std::vector), cache locality.

topics.name: Singly & Doubly Linked Lists
topics.description: Node pointers, dynamic memory allocation, insertion, deletion, cycle detection (Floyd's algorithm).

topics.name: Stacks & Queues
topics.description: LIFO/FIFO properties, array and linked list backings, parentheses matching, monotonic stacks.

topics.name: Recursion & Backtracking
topics.description: Call stack execution, base conditions, recurrence trees, N-Queens, subset generation.

topics.name: Binary Trees & Tree Traversals
topics.description: Node structures, Inorder, Preorder, Postorder (recursive and iterative with stack), Level-order.

topics.name: Binary Search Trees (BST) & AVL Trees
topics.description: BST invariant, searching, insertion, deletion, AVL rotations, balanced tree height guarantees.

topics.name: Binary Heaps & Priority Queues
topics.description: Min-heap/Max-heap property, array representation, heapify up/down, priority queues.

topics.name: Graph Representation (Adjacency Matrix & List)
topics.description: Vertices, edges, directed vs undirected, adjacency matrix vs adjacency list trade-offs.

topics.name: Graph Traversals (BFS & DFS)
topics.description: Breadth-First Search using queues, Depth-First Search using recursion/stack, connected components.

topics.name: Topological Sort & DAG Cycle Detection
topics.description: Kahn's in-degree algorithm (queue), DFS back-edge detection, course scheduling models.

topics.name: Single-Source Shortest Paths (Dijkstra's Algorithm)
topics.description: Greedy relaxation, min-heap priority queue optimization, non-negative edge weights.

topics.name: Minimum Spanning Trees (Prim's & Kruskal's with Disjoint Sets)
topics.description: Cut property, Union-Find Disjoint Set data structure (path compression + rank), greedy MST.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming (Memoization & Tabulation)
topics.description: Overlapping subproblems, optimal substructure, 1D/2D DP, 0/1 Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence.

topics.name: Graph Dynamic Programming & All-Pairs Shortest Path
topics.description: Floyd-Warshall algorithm, Bellman-Ford negative cycle detection, DAG longest path DP.
